en: Two-sided illustrated postcard. The front shows a colorful, cartoon-style map of the Mecseki Kultúrpark area in Pécs, Hungary, highlighting the Zoo (ZOO PÉCS) with drawings of animals such as a lion, jaguar, otter, bird of prey, and a white fallow deer. It also depicts the Vidám Park (amusement park) with icons for a Ferris wheel, roller coaster, boats, bumper cars, and an airplane ride, along with labeled roads and landmarks including the TV tower (TV-TORONY) and Domorkapu. The reverse side is a standard divided postcard back with address lines, a stamp box, and Hungarian text giving contact information and opening hours for the Mecseki Kultúrpark in Pécs, plus publisher information.
